title: Ontology
description: A versioned collection of LabelDefinitions that forms the complete taxonomy for structured context classification. Ontologies define the set of labels available for classifying events.

type.description: Ontology type identifier (e.g., 'user', 'enterprise', 'domain'). Used with version to form the full ontology reference.

version.description: Semantic version of the ontology (e.g., '1.0.0'). MUST follow Semantic Versioning 2.0.0.

labels.description: All label definitions in this ontology.

label_count.description: Total number of labels in this ontology. MUST equal the length of the 'labels' array.

oneOf.description: Optional metadata about the ontology (author, description, domain, etc.).
